summary: Fox Corp disclosed entry into a $1.0 billion senior unsecured term loan facility on June 30, 2026, to partially fund its acquisition of Roku, Inc., which was announced on June 15, 2026, per a June 14 merger agreement. The facility, with Morgan Stanley as administrative agent, matures two years post-closing and includes an accordion feature for up to $1.0 billion in additional term loans. Interest rates are based on Base Rate or Term SOFR plus margins tied to Fox's credit ratings. The filing provides financing details; no premium or other terms for the Roku acquisition were stated. The closing is contingent on customary conditions; watch for regulatory approval progress.
